current.messageZh: 寒冷天氣警告現正生效，天氣寒冷可能影響健康，市民應小心保暖。
current.messageEn: The Cold Weather Warning is now in force. Cold weather might cause adverse health effects. Members of the public should take care to keep warm.

forecast.generalSituationZh: 受強烈東北季候風影響，今早廣東地區寒冷。隨著覆蓋華南的廣闊雲帶逐漸遠離，今日該區天色短暫好轉。而一股達強風程度的偏東氣流會在下週初影響華南沿岸，該區雲量增多，氣溫略為回升。預料另一股東北季候風會在下星期二抵達華南沿岸，下週中期該區氣溫再度下降及有幾陣雨。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, it will be cold over Guangdong this morning. With the broad band of clouds covering southern China departing gradually, the weather will improve briefly over the region today. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China early next week. It will be cloudier with temperatures rising slightly over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China next Tuesday. Temperatures will fall again and there will be a few rain patches over the region midweek next week.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。日間部分時間有陽光及乾燥。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
days.windZh: 北風4至5級，初時高地間中6級。後轉東風4至5級。
days.windEn: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first, becoming east force 4 to 5 later.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。稍後有一兩陣微雨。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches later.
days.windEn: East force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherEn: Cloudy with one or two rain patches.
days.windZh: 東風4級，初時5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 4, force 5 at first, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 多雲，有幾陣雨。稍後氣溫下降。
days.weatherEn: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Temperatures will fall later.
days.windEn: East force 4, becoming north force 4 to 5.

days.weatherZh: 多雲，有幾陣雨。天氣轉涼。
days.weatherEn: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Becoming cool.
days.windZh: 北至東北風4級，初時間中5級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5 at first.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲。早上清涼，有一兩陣雨，日間部分時間天色明朗。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy. Cool with one or two rain patches in the morning. Bright periods during the day.
Mainly fine. Dry during the day.
